name: United Kingdom
names: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

tips.livery: bus operator colour + route number → search "<city> <colour> bus"; TfL red is Greater London only as a first filter (other towns run red buses). Read the operator name on the side (Stagecoach, First, Arriva, Go-Ahead, National Express, a municipal fleet) and look the route up with `osm.py route`.
tips.municipal: council name on wheelie bins, lamp columns, street-name plates and planning notices; Welsh/English bilingual official signs → Wales; Scottish Gaelic bilingual official signs → Highlands and the Western Isles
